separationRule: Runtime normalizedText is product output and is tested by its own fixtures; quality scoring consumes raw reference and raw hypothesis only and never uses runtime normalizedText.
normalization: Apply Unicode NFKC independently to the raw reference and raw hypothesis.
Apply the frozen OpenCC t2s mapping independently to each side.
Apply Unicode lowercase independently to each side.
Retain only code points in U+4E00..U+9FFF and ASCII A-Z, a-z, or 0-9; discard every other code point, including whitespace and punctuation.

unitAndDistance.aggregation: Compute errors and reference units independently per clip, then sum errors and units across the exact ordered corpus.

symmetry: The identical normalization and unit function applies to reference and hypothesis.
prohibitions: Do not mutate a raw transcript before retaining it as evidence.
Do not score the product-facing twp-to-cn normalizedText.
Do not use different normalization for the baseline and current package.
Do not change the scoring contract, map, baseline, or threshold inside implementation or API/E2E.
